title: Prompt - Timelessness
evidence: The task is entirely self-contained. No external website lookups are required — all information needed is in the four input files (coin texture, 3D model, reference image, config file). No time-sensitive data is involved (no stock prices, news, weather, live APIs). No URLs or web resources are referenced. The gameplay_config.txt provides all numeric values. The scene_reference.png provides the visual spec. The prompt does not depend on any external service or data that could change over time.
